programme.desc: 'S24/E10 - Roadmaster Rick'. When Rick and Corey discover a newfound love for an old Buick Roadmaster, will they be able to rev up a deal? Later, Chum checks out a doll and volleyball signed by Tom Hanks.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S8/E18 - Lock The Vote'. Darrell has to shoulder the burden of a possible bad locker as Mary tries to get in touch with her inner Californian. Jarrod and Brandi have a good history in the area.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S8/E19 - All Bid And No Bite'. Mary has to stay on a budget and learns a lesson about Dave. Rene tries a secret strategy, while Jarrod and Brandi try to hit the auctions with some old-school style.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S8/E20 - Just Deserts'. Ivy uses a tactic to get a rise from the competition as the auction forces Mary to travel out of her comfort zone. Rene steps up his game, and Darrell tries to score.

programme.title: Storage Wars
programme.desc: 'S9/E1 - Palm Springs Throwdown'. The buyers head to Palm Springs where the prices aren't the only things that get hot under the sun. Ivy brings his game with his sights set on a high roller locker.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S8/E42 of 50 - Flip The Forge'. In this competition the judges flip the script once again, letting the bladesmiths choose their challenge. Will they take it easy or go big to impress the judges?

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S9/E14 of 22 - Fastest Blade In The West'. In one of the most unique first rounds in Forged in Fire history, four bladesmiths must giddy-up to finish their blade first and become the fastest blade in the West.

programme.title: Forged In Fire
programme.desc: 'S9/E16 of 22 - Friend Or Foe'. Two friends and two brothers enter the forge as competing teams. But after working to recreate a Scottish broadsword, the victorious team will be divided and forced to face each other.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S1/E1 - Where Ark Thou?'. Both the Ark of the Covenant and Noah's Ark were built to protect, before they were lost to history. Researchers have been searching for both for centuries.

programme.title: Holy Marvels With Dennis Quaid
programme.desc: 'S1/E2 - The Keys To Immortality'. The quest for immortality has captivated and confounded us for thousands of years. From the healing powers of the holy grail used by Jesus at the last supper, to the elusive Fountain of Youth.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E5 - Judas: The Betrayal'. What prompted one of Jesus' closest friends to turn on him? It remains one of the Bible's great mysteries, one explored as Jesus and his disciples enter Jerusalem for Passover and the Last Supper.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E6 - Pilate: The Trial'. Pontius Pilate, the Roman governor of Judea, has to make a decision about a troublesome preacher called Jesus. As pressure builds to execute Jesus, Pilate's wife urges him to leave Jesus alone.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E7 - Mary Magdalene: The Crucifixion'. With Jesus' mother, Mary witnesses the torment of the crucifixion from the foot of the cross. But her faith is rewarded the most when she is the first to witness the resurrection.

programme.title: Jesus: His Life
programme.desc: 'S1/E8 - Peter: The Resurrection'. A simple fisherman, Peter was Jesus' most devoted disciple. After Peter disavows Jesus during Jesus' arrest, the resurrected Jesus appears to Peter and restores him.

programme.title: Secrets In The Sand
programme.desc: 'S2/E7 - Screaming Mummy & Chaco Canyon Highway'. In Egypt, a mysterious mummy's anguished face defies burial customs. In Iraq, a buried palace reveals secrets of Sumerian power.

programme.title: Gold Wars Downunder
programme.desc: 'S1/E5'. At Scratchy Moo, Matt and Damo are weighing up the two offers they have received for their land. Leigh ups the ante with a bizarre 11th hour offer - he wants to trade his 32-tonne excavator for the land.

programme.title: Swamp People
programme.desc: 'S17/E2 - Flash Flood'. As historic floodwaters from the north swallow the bayou, Troy and Pickle struggle with drowned lines, until a lesson from a late swamp legend gives them a fighting chance.

programme.title: Mysteries Unearthed With Danny Trejo
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - National Treasures'. From a bat swung by one of baseball's boldest pioneers, to an iconic painting hidden behind a false wall, these finds prove that America's treasures can turn up in the most unlikely places.

programme.title: The Unxplained With William Shatner
programme.desc: 'S7/E3 - Secret Societies'. The idea that a some organisations control world events has been around for centuries. The Mafia, Skull & Bones, and the Freemasons are just a few of these groups said to meet behind closed doors.

programme.title: The Last Hours Of Jesus Christ
programme.desc: From his arrestation to his resurrection, a lot of questions still surround the last hours of Jesus' life. Recent discoveries and experts' analysis shed some light on this enigma. Did Jesus really die on the cross?

programme.title: MasterChef South Africa
programme.desc: 'S6/E8 - Fowl Play'. The home cooks face a tricky MasterChef challenge creating fine-dining tasting plates using chicken and its gizzards. Who will rise to rule the roost?

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S2/E1 - 2/1'. An anonymous tip leads to a gruesome find. Eren and Ilgaz try to keep it under wraps to protect a potential witness. Pars is made Chief Prosecutor.

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S2/E2 - 2/2'. Ceylin and Ilgaz discover that their cases are linked. Yekta struggles to adjust to his new circumstances, and Eren identifies the first body in the well.

programme.title: Bloedspoor
programme.desc: 'S2/E3 - 2/3'. Neva's death shatters Pars. Cinar tries to find Serdar, and Aylin meets Cetin in person. Ceylin puts Tolga to work as a stand-in lawyer for her young client.
